messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Recommended Dosage in Adult Patients The recommended starting dosage of Lipitor is 10 mg to 20 mg once daily. The dosage range is 10 mg to 80 mg once daily. Patients who require a reduction in LDL-C greater than 45% may be started at 40 mg once daily.
Recommended Dosage in Pediatric Patients 10 Years of Age and Older with HeFH The recommended starting dosage of Lipitor is 10 mg once daily. The dosage range is 10 mg to 20 mg once daily.
Recommended Dosage in Pediatric Patients 10 Years of Age and Older with HoFH The recommended starting dosage of Lipitor is 10 mg to 20 mg once daily. The dosage range is 10 mg to 80 mg once daily.
Comments: Assess LDL-C when clinically appropriate, as early as 4 weeks after initiating Lipitor, and adjust the dosage if necessary.
This medicine is available as: atorvastatin 10 mg tablets, atorvastatin 20 mg tablets, atorvastatin 40 mg tablet, 80 mg tablets.
The original brand name of atorvastatin was Lipitor, and now it is also available as a generic. Atorvastatin calcium oral suspension is also available as the brand Aorvaliq 20mg/5ml.
Triplet: ["Atorvastatin", "has dosage range", "10 mg to 80 mg once daily"]

The relation 'has dosage range' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is available in a dosage range specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
B. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
